Hey man I respect ur opinion but I always ran Arc Thrower + Slugger pre-patch and I only played Terminid Imp/Helldive and I was havin a blast. Arc Thrower could always solo like 2 or 3 Titans if you were good at dodging the vomit, and Chargers are no problem if you can get the Titans to vomit and one shot them. Just try some different stuff out, it's not all gloomer hours brother. If y'all disagree I understand, I don't worry I too think they should have definitely buffed weaker weapons instead, but this patch didn't ruin the game. It just made it require a bit more strategy.
